intro: From the Urdu Wikipedia article on Albert Einstein: the opening lines and the start of the section on his early life in Germany and Italy. The article refers to him with the plain “hua / tha” rather than the respectful plural, and gives some names in English letters too.

sentences.urdu: البرٹ آئنسٹائن (Albert Einstein)، بیسویں صدی کا سب سے بڑا طبیعیات دان سمجھا جاتا ہے۔
sentences.english: Albert Einstein is considered the greatest physicist of the twentieth century.

sentences.urdu: جرمنی کے شہر اولم میں 14 مارچ 1879ء کو پیدا ہوا۔
sentences.english: He was born on 14 March 1879 in the German city of Ulm.

sentences.urdu: باپ کا نام ہرمین (Hermann Einstein) اور ماں کا نام پالین (Pauline Koch) تھا۔
sentences.english: His father's name was Hermann (Hermann Einstein) and his mother's name was Pauline (Pauline Koch).

sentences.urdu: آئنسٹائن کا خاندان جرمنی کے خوش حال یہودی النسل خاندانوں میں شمار ہوتا تھا۔
sentences.english: Einstein's family was counted among the well-off families of Jewish descent in Germany.

sentences.urdu: باپ کاروباری تھا مگر زیادہ کامیاب نہیں تھا۔
sentences.english: His father was a businessman, but not a very successful one.

sentences.urdu: جب آئنسٹائن چھ برس کا تھا، یہ لوگ میونخ آ گئے۔
sentences.english: When Einstein was six years old, the family moved to Munich.

sentences.urdu: ابتدائی تعلیم ایک کاتھولک مدرسہ میں پائی۔
sentences.english: He received his early education at a Catholic school.

sentences.urdu: یہاں کا سخت ماحول اس بچے کو ناگوار گزرتا تھا۔
sentences.english: The strict atmosphere there was unpleasant for the boy.

sentences.urdu: سن 1894ء میں آئنسٹائن کو بورڈنگ مدرسہ میں پیچھے چھوڑ کر، اس کا باپ کاروباری وجوہات کی بنا پر خاندان سمیت اٹلی منتقل ہو گیا۔
sentences.english: In 1894, leaving Einstein behind at a boarding school, his father moved to Italy with the family for business reasons.

sentences.urdu: دسمبر 1894ء میں سولہ سال کی عمر میں تعلیم ادھوری چھوڑ کر آئنسٹائن (غالباً جرمن کی لازمی فوجی سروس کے خوف سے ) خود بھی اٹلی پہنچ گیا۔
sentences.english: In December 1894, at the age of sixteen, Einstein left his education unfinished and (probably for fear of compulsory German military service) went to Italy himself as well.

sentences.urdu: وہاں پہنچ کر سن 1896ء میں اس نے جرمن شہریت چھوڑ دی۔
sentences.english: After arriving there, in 1896 he gave up his German citizenship.

بڑا: great; big (“sab se baṛa” = the greatest)
النسل: by descent (“yahoodi un-nasl” = of Jewish descent)
شمار: counting (“mein shumaar hona” = to be counted among)
برس: year(s) (“chhe baras ka” = six years old)
لوگ: people (“ye log” = they, i.e. the family)
ناگوار: unpleasant (“naagawaar guzarna” = to be unpleasant for)
چھوڑ: leave (“chhoṛ kar” = leaving; “chhoṛ di” = gave up)
بنا: basis (“ki bina par” = on account of)
عمر: age (“solah saal ki umr mein” = at the age of sixteen)
پہنچ: reach (“pahunch gaya” = arrived; “pahunch kar” = after arriving)

questions.urdu: آئنسٹائن کس شہر میں پیدا ہوا؟
questions.english: In which city was Einstein born?

questions.urdu: آئنسٹائن کو کاتھولک مدرسہ کیسا لگتا تھا؟
questions.english: How did Einstein feel about the Catholic school?

options.urdu: وہاں کا سخت ماحول اسے ناگوار گزرتا تھا
options.english: He found its strict atmosphere unpleasant

questions.urdu: مضمون کے مطابق آئنسٹائن غالباً کس چیز کے خوف سے اٹلی گیا؟
questions.english: According to the article, Einstein probably went to Italy for fear of what?

options.urdu: جرمنی کی لازمی فوجی سروس کے
